draft.summary:
NFL.com graded him 5.90, the 143rd-best grade among 253 2019 draftees and 21st of 28 at WR. He lasted until pick 247, well after his grade rank (143rd): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Ryan Grant
. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 796 receiving yards in 2018, 19th of 28 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2020. 32 career games and 9 starts over 2 completed seasons. Career-best season: 3 AV in 2019. Weak spots: receiving td 0 (13th percentile).
